claimBoundary: The browser traversal proves visible identity and context continuity across pre-seeded review surfaces only.
The review browser fixture is read-only and must not be cited as evidence that a mutation persisted between products.
Mutation, idempotency, replay, and provenance claims require separately hashed reports from real server actions executed against isolated temporary databases.

sourceNote.body: Mara & Finn’s menu tasting at The Orchard is booked for 1 August. Confirm the final dietary list before the venue team locks the service notes.

contextInvariants: The same workspace and project identities are used in every product.
Product switching uses only /app/notes, /app/tasks, and /app/timeline; Home is the authenticated front door.
Switching products preserves the active workspace and project context.
Every derived object retains a durable reference to its immediate source.
Signal evidence resolves back to the exact task and milestone; it is not synthetic summary copy.

expected: The exact private source note is visible and selected.
Its existing Tasks receipt names demo-task-menu-tasting.
No browser mutation or cross-product persistence is claimed.
The receipt opens the canonical Tasks route in the same app.
The task query resolves demo-task-menu-tasting exactly.
Workspace and project context remain The Orchard, events and Mara & Finn.
The exact pre-seeded task appears once in the active project.
Its title, date, source-note receipt, and existing milestone state match the fixture contract.
The browser does not claim to create or promote this task.
The active project opens directly in its owner artifact.
The public milestone associated in the review evidence report appears once at the correct date.
Preview and share do not mutate the owner timeline.
The briefing describes only evidence available from the active project.
The observation links back to the exact task and milestone.
Partial provider failure is disclosed rather than silently replaced.
The briefing remains a capability inside Home and is not presented as a fourth product.

requiredEvidence: one continuous deterministic read-only browser traversal per viewport
approved baseline and visual diff for every screenshot
separately hashed real server-action and temporary-database mutation reports
receipt hashes bound to the exact commit and fixture manifest

proves: the source note is created once
the exact approved extract creates one task
the task retains the exact source-note identity
an identical retry replays the same task receipt
a retry does not create a duplicate task
a changed destination or approved body is rejected
the exact task is promoted to a milestone
the owner-side Timeline source relation retains the task identity
the frozen public DTO omits the private source relation
the opaque Signal entry resolves server-side to the exact task
the rebuilt evidence remains scoped to the authorised workspace and project
the review evidence report associates that task with the public milestone without adding source identity to the public DTO

certification.reason: The fixture structure defines a truthful hybrid proof, but neither the continuous read-only browser traversals nor the separately hashed server-action and temporary-database mutation reports have been captured.
